expected_level_description: You can: - keep project documents in the right place, with version control - update action, risk, and issue logs when asked
You can: - explain the stages of a project and the main roles in it - keep project records such as action logs
You can: - run a range of administrative processes for a team with little supervision - spot and fix errors in records and data - suggest simpler ways of working

You can: - produce well-formatted documents and presentations quickly and accurately - use spreadsheets to sort, filter, and summarise data - use collaboration tools to manage shared documents and versions
You can: - manage diaries for a team, resolving clashes - arrange travel, events, and meetings with outside partners - make sure papers and actions are ready before meetings
You can: - write accurate, concise minutes and action logs for routine meetings - follow up actions with their owners
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
